author: izjust4fun
body:
Random suggestions for the server!


Achievements.


~ Individual/Career Achievements for all game modes. Earning achievements award credits.

Examples~

Nebula~ Break 250 monuments. Shoot a player from over 75 blocks away.

etc.. etc…


Trails and pets.

~ Bring em both back. Maybe add them to the credit shop or something!


HG/SG Events.


~ Have a dedicated server for hosting big HG/SG games (50 players).

~ Sr Mods+ can start them and announce them via broadcast.


Parkour.


~ Add a parkour game mode. Could have 3 different signs for 3 different difficulties (beginner/intermediate/expert). Each map has it's own levels/stages and multiple check points within them, finishing a level/stage/and completing the map rewards credits.


Rank name changes.


~ I know it's been brought up before plenty of times in the past, but I think we should change em possibly back to the old donor rank names.

Gold~ VIP

Emerald~ Elite

Diamond~ Titan


Skywars.


~ Bring it back? :D


Hardcore games.


~ Put the servers back online pls!

replies.body:
I agree with all of your ideas except the name changes.
The names we use are unique and if we were to change, then keep the names unique too.

A parkour server would be a calm, relaxing gamemode to go on. Perhaps a large rectangular area where you have to parkour to get to the other side where there's a piston door and you then enter another area and it sets your home there.

Nice ideas, we must talk to Kylo in the next meeting. c:
